title: C2 Hercules (Crusader Industries, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The C2 Hercules is a heavy lift transport from Crusader Industries in Star Citizen, flown by a crew of two. The two-seat cockpit sits high in the nose above the huge cargo bay. VTOL mode on left base button 5 helps when landing.

panels.name: C2 Hercules: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the C2 Hercules's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The C2 Hercules has two guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Cargo (696 SCU)
controls.text: The huge bay holds 696 SCU. For landing heavy, the pilot uses VTOL mode.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: C2 Hercules: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the C2 Hercules besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Remote turrets (two)
controls.text: Two remote turrets defend the C2 Hercules. It is aimed through a camera from inside the ship.
controls.context: A remote turret is aimed from a seat inside the ship through a camera, not from a glass bubble on the turret itself.
